subject: Archaeology
title: The Mary Rose: Henry VIII's Flagship
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Mary Rose: Henry VIII's Flagship.

hook.text: Henry VIII watched helplessly from shore as his favorite warship sank during a French attack in 1545.

buildup.text: The Mary Rose capsized in the Solent, drowning most of its 400-man crew. Open gun ports let water flood in as it turned.

discovery.text: Raised in 1982, the wreck contained 19,000 artifacts: longbows, medical kits, backgammon sets.

twist.text: DNA analysis of the crew revealed men from Africa and Southern Europe — Tudor England was more diverse than assumed.

climax.text: The Mary Rose is now displayed in Portsmouth with its artifacts — a complete snapshot of Tudor life at sea.

punchline.text: A king's warship sank with a pet dog, board games, and a multinational crew.

quiz.question: What did DNA analysis of the Mary Rose crew reveal?
options: All crew members were from the same English county
The crew included men from Africa and Southern Europe — Tudor England was diverse
Most sailors were former prisoners pressed into naval service
